intent: User-authorized default Max narration level balancing; raw engine output remains bit-exact with 0.9

goals.ordinaryWaveform: constant gain; no resampling, automatic gain riding, time shift, clipping or limiter activation in qualified recordings

limits: Targets are engineering acceptance goals, not a claim that BS.1770 prescribes a -26 LUFS audiobook level
Reference-style offsets are measured relative to that voice's Neutral reference, then bounded to +/-3 LU; they are not inferred from sentiment
One fixed gain per voice/language/style preserves within-utterance dynamics; extreme native style contrasts are intentionally bounded
Boosts have a memoryless emergency soft knee above 0.9 amplitude; report any activation in measured audio
Human listening remains required before release promotion
Initial +6 dB boost cap left German calibration voices 4.5 LU apart; +9 dB chosen from calibration medians reduces that gap to 1.5 LU. Holdout peaks do not choose per-profile gains.
